title: Rejecting communion with the erring and holding to the Nicene creed
english: I admit neither communion with them nor access to them. I hold to the orthodox and unadulterated faith, which the blessed and saving creed in Nicaea confirmed. And . . . [text broken] . . . Apollinarius . . .

orientation: Cyril is speaking in the first person, stating his own stance after quoting Scripture against those who err.

title: Rejection of imposed commands and condemnation of church disturbers
english: And the letter . . . to me from the church . . . For this is the act of a persecutor. [The papyrus is broken here; the letter's sender and content are unknown.] Nor did I impose anything upon the pious, for that would be foolish and senseless. But those who disturb the church among us and its Christ-loving people . . .
